verdict.rationale: A GPU accelerator's management stack (AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Device Metrics Exporter) could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on rocm.docs.amd.com all returned 404. An llms.txt docs index exists, but that is a related feature rather than an API spec.
